ambiguities: Mme de Guermantes is mentioned only as the source of inherited traits that make Saint-Loup endearing ('les traits mêmes de Mme de Guermantes en son neveu'), and as the object of a now-waived favor; neither reference stages her as a participant with a distinct local outcome, so she was omitted.

Le narrateur initiates and receives the mutual tutoiement with Saint-Loup, which could be read as his own inclusion in an intimate bond; however, this is the mirror side of the already-accepted elevation event for Saint-Loup rather than a distinct outcome for the narrator, and his surrounding commentary ('peut-être je voulais le prendre par l'amour-propre; peut-être aussi j'étais sincère') is retrospective self-analysis rather than a staged social positioning, so he was not scored.
